title_zh: 约定书面确认展示柜借期延长的例外条件

scenario.label_zh: 约定书面确认展示柜借期延长的例外条件
scenario.goal_zh: 核对借用展示柜的归还期限，并约定在书面延期确认前仍按原期限安排归还

context_zh: 虚构地方展览的组织者向器材出借员询问能否多借一天展示柜，纯属服务沟通练习。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Does our loan agreement oblige us to return the display case on Friday, even if the exhibition runs late?

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Yes. That’s the agreed date. I may be able to allow one extra day, but I need to check the next booking.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Would that set a precedent for future exhibitions? We don’t want anyone to assume extensions are automatic.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: No. If Saturday is free, I’ll send a written exception for this loan only, with a new return time.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Then we’ll keep Friday’s return arrangements unless we receive that confirmation.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: That’s right. I’ll check the booking now, but please don’t change your transport yet.
